## RecordApprovalDecisionOptions.writer property

Audit writer. \*\*Required\*\*, unlike [EnforceCallOptions.writer](./core.enforcecalloptions.writer.md)<!-- -->: a human decision that resolves a held call must always be persisted, so there is no "decide but do not record" mode to fall into.
